senses.gloss:
कपिकच्छू̆
MUCUNA PRURITA HOOK. (Chopra; KB 1, p. 778-780; MW; Nadk. 1,
nr. 1663; PA 1, 5, p. 4; PW) = M. PRURIENS DC. (Dutt; DWH 1, p.
447-450; HK; PA 1, 5, p. 4) [= M. PRURIENS BAK. (non DC.)] (Bpn,
p. 357; Chopra; KB 1, p. 778-780; Nadk. 1, nr. 1663) = M. PRURIENS
(Avk; Dgv, nr. 111; Na 1, nr. 166; V 3, p. 20-21; Vśs) = M. UTILIS
WALL. (PA 1, 5, p. 14; acc. to Hooker 2, p. 187 this is a cultivated
variety with a velvety pod) = CARPOPOGON PRURIENS ROXB. (Avk;
Dutt; HK; Nadk. 1, nr. 1663; PA 1, 5, p. 14; Roxb., p. 553; Vśs) =
DOLICHOS PRURIENS LINN. (Ainslie 1, p. 92-94; Nadk. 1, nr. 1663).
